text:
Q: Which desk accepts a moon token?
A: The rules in this conversation concern Velvet Desks, also called soft counters.
Do not file a moon token unless its reverse is marked.
Exception: an unmarked token may rest in the waiting tray, never in the ledger.
The waiting tray rule qualifies the preceding prohibition.
